metadata.title: Nonexistence of solutions to $Δ_pu+Δ_qu+u^s|\nabla u|^t\leq 0$ on geodesically complete noncompact Riemannian manifolds
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we consider the inequality $\Delta_pu+\Delta_qu+u^s|\nabla u|^t\leq 0$ on geodesically complete noncompact Riemannian manifolds. By a test function argument, we establish Liouville-type theorems under the upper bound of volume of geodesic ball. In the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$, we obtain new nonexistence results which extend the result of Bhakta-Biswas-Filippucci \cite{BBF}. In particular, we have addressed the influence of the higher order term for $s<0$. At last, we present some examples to illustrate sharpness in some cases.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在完备非紧流形上，为含 p、q 拉普拉斯和梯度非线性的微分不等式建立体积增长控制下的 Liouville 型非存在定理。
analysis.breakthrough: 处理 s<0 时较高阶算子的影响，扩大欧氏及流形非存在范围。
analysis.limitations: 指数可行区域及尖锐性仅在部分情形获得；摘要未列出全部参数范围。 数学分析仅依据摘要及评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何 PDE 与体积增长直接相联，技术偏推广型。
